features.catalog_choice: yes (flat list, product and channel in each row, search)
features.default_selection: branding `default_image`, then catalog `default_image`; else you must pick
features.connectivity_check: blocks on source and confirm when the image needs a download, not for a copy of this computer's system; probes the image's registry first; Network settings button
features.hostname: field on confirm, first value from the image
features.account_groups: wheel, sudo and developer groups, operator override
features.locale_pages: Session step: a change applies to the live session and goes into the recipe; XKB layouts; listed on confirm; checked by fisherman validate
features.cancel_install: Cancel button and window close: each asks first; a cancelled page follows
features.translatable: strings marked with qsTr; template `i18n/tuna-installer-niri.ts`; ships `i18n/tuna-installer-niri_fr.ts` as a `.qm`, loaded for the locale by `translations/` (a QML module); catalogs kept current by a check (#300)
features.source_check: confirm page, Selected image card; a blocked source holds Install
features.install_plan: yes: the target disk (model, size, serial; unknown when the disk does not report it) and each device erased, on a card of the confirm page; Install binds the recipe to that disk with `diskIdentity`, and to the plan with `planBinding` when fisherman reports `plan.binding`; without a plan (an older fisherman) the page is as before
features.bootc_store_view: yes, on the confirm page; the system that this computer runs is a second install source there (experimental, never the default, never on live media)
features.source_reuse_progress: yes: a line under the step line; the bar holds until the first step; the cancel card says that the disk does not change
features.done_receipt: yes: install ID and first-boot check, or the reason
features.log_after_failure: log in page; the failure page says whether the disk was changed, and when the cleanup failed or timed out
